body: Example testimony: At the onboarding office, staff rushed contracts in Dutch without translating fuel/deduction rules, and weeks later money was taken off net wages. Never sign blindly—keep recruiter screenshots and demand full written terms to submit to SNCU & Arbeidsinspectie.

Example testimony: Instead of applying host-company ADV hours, payroll placed statutory vakantie-uren into minus (-€890) and tried to reclaim earlier fuel lines. Under BW Art. 7:638, 7:628 & 7:632, workers can demand full repayment and file directly with SNCU & employment lawyers.

Example testimony: Planning stopped calling back, left workers in agency housing without shifts or guaranteed pay while deducting weekly rent, and told them to use their own phone and car. Send a written availability notice (BW Art. 7:628) and attach call logs for Arbeidsinspectie.

Example testimony: Agencies count on international workers staying silent or leaving the country without filing forms. When our community votes, comments, and payslip proofs are exported together, Nederlandse Arbeidsinspectie, SNCU, Politie, and EU ELA receive undeniable collective evidence.
